$comment: Golden vectors for the topic grammar. Consumed by BOTH contracts/src/topics/topics.test.ts (vitest) and contracts/rust tests (cargo). A vector added on one side fails the other side's CI until implemented — that is the feature.

build.why: the offering half of the room `--room` defaults to: Soundcard_to_webrtc has the media, so it is the side that knows a session is wanted
Webrtc_to_Soundcard always answers; each side publishes its own role and subscribes to the other's, which is what pairs exactly two agents
both halves of one call - what a monitor watching a room subscribes to
the publish flourish, by the name the sound host knows it by (PLAN-3315.01)
how many times the shell's watchdog replaced the sound host - retained, so it is found on connect
the synthesised reply the sound host plays - nothing subscribed to it before PLAN-3315.01
the whole family is this one retained topic, and the consumer ignores a stale siren
YoControl's ten-second heartbeat - live, so a dead agent stops saying ONLINE
the room is in the topic, not the payload
the fader Protocol-midi's own unit test asserts - mapper.rs:99, so the builder and the mapper are pinned to one string
the top channel: the MIDI 1.0 status byte carries four bits, so ch15 is the last one there is
mapper.rs's fourth arm passes the driver's message type through verbatim, so the leaf is open and still held to the segment charset
every channel and control of one surface
the whole family is this one topic - one publisher, one subscriber, and both name this string
the whole family is this one topic - KOMAND's retained hour phase (boom, reconnecting, self_test, running) that every recorder obeys
the whole family is this one topic - the agent's retained record of which controls are reading the clock out loud, so a restart does not forget them while every tick box stays ticked (PLAN-736.01)
a retained setting, minted by its own builder so retained-state is reachable from the kind alone - the same reason bareMetal.command exists
no path at all: the root IS the topic
key and terminal are ADDRESSES, not plain segments - an IP_port pair and a MAC, both of which SEGMENT_RE would refuse
a leading underscore is significant in a DNS-SD service type and a trailing dot is ubiquitous in an FQDN; neither is trimmed here
the tail must be at least one segment and must not be status or config: classifyLegacy claims the bare proto and those two leaves as the older spelling of this root
the scan's narration line, minted by its own builder so live-event is reachable from the kind alone
minted by agent-counters.ts / agent_counters.rs rather than by Topics - the payload and its topic are one contract
ESP32/AUDIO/AUDIO.json declares this leaf a _SmartToggle with is_sticky: true - a setpoint, so it is retained state and not a command
mqtt_agent.py:199 publishes this RETAINED on every start, composed as f-string - a target addressed with no host segment at all
spacenavigator_probe.py:535 publishes status retain=True; a probe names its CLASS before its host, which is why the tail is open
the host segment is an ADDRESS, not a plain segment: it is whatever socket.gethostname() returned and may be an FQDN
DATA.NETWORK's NETWORK.json declares {node}/announce; the target is a manifest tree, node-addressed like PI
DATA.NTP's CLOCK.NTP.json module topic, one node
a _GuiActuator one-shot, minted by its own builder so live-event is reachable from the kind alone
linux_desktop_monitor.py:313 publishes telemetry with NO retain flag - a retained sample is a stale one
the bench chat line YoControl and the shell's Chat both name - two literals before 2026-10-30
a roster seat is a shellSeat, built through gui_seat
YoControl's own standing SOS (100_outputs SOS_YO_TOPIC)
PLUGIN.VISA's device_prefix, formatted at every call site before 2026-10-30
the write daemon's subscription (write_daemon/mod.rs)
the caller's retained draw - payload BingoDrawn
YoControl's cepo.command shape, {unit}/{command}/Set
DockTor's events - the bare root, live
Storage-Portal: the stack is a level (report.py container_topic)
names are addresses: a dot is allowed
DockTor's chat line (api.py CHAT_TOPIC)
ESP32_Beskar2d2 0.3.0's status and Will leaf
MqttProvider.jsx flagNearestRustAgentHandoff, retained
the census summary, also the node's Last Will
BankBars' list of every DMM

buildInvalid.why: the engine leaves are closed at two - a per-second tick is the frame's own ping, not a bus leaf
space in a cue name - a cue is one segment
Yo/announce is its own topic, not a speech leaf
space in a room name - a room is one segment
the role set is closed at two: the roles are fixed by direction, and a third participant would be a different topology
space in room segment
slash injection in room - a room name is one segment
there is no seventeenth MIDI channel: the status byte carries four bits, so the vocabulary is closed at ch0..ch15
mapper.rs takes channel as a u8 and could build this with format!; the builder refuses it, which is the whole benefit of declaring the family
slash injection in the device identifier - a device is one segment
slash injection in the control leaf - the leaf is open, not unbounded
slash injection in deviceId
MQTT single-level wildcard in deviceId
MQTT multi-level wildcard in deviceId
deviceId missing protocol: prefix
space in protocol segment
empty protocol segment
slash injection in deviceId
deviceId missing protocol: prefix
space in protocol segment
slash injection in deviceId
deviceId missing protocol: prefix
space in protocol segment
upper case in deviceId protocol prefix (only [a-z0-9_])
dash in deviceId protocol prefix (only [a-z0-9_])
space in test path segment
slash injection in suite
empty suite
space in DataMigration key
RepositoryManager needs at least one path segment
wildcard char in agent
empty agent
verb outside SET/RIG/NAB/DO
empty dotted segment in capability
level outside closed enum
Sweep is a reserved leaf: a point in a category so named would be indistinguishable from the stream reporting on the set of points
Poke is the other reserved leaf, for the same reason
slash injection in a key - address class widens the alphabet, it does not stop refusing the separator
space in the category, which is a plain segment and not an address
space in the capture kind - a capture is named, not addressed, so it stays segment class
MQTT multi-level wildcard in the protocol name
space in a protocols path segment
space in the FileBrowser key
the engine's leaves are plain segments
a panel key is ONE segment - the runner folds the device path with sanitize_segment
slash injection in the agent name
the target set is CLOSED - a seventh target is an edit to BAREMETAL_TARGETS, not a topic that quietly appears
command is a live-event leaf; the retain class must never be a function of what a caller put in the last position
telemetry is a live-event leaf - use bareMetal.stream
a space in a segment: the tail is address-class, which still refuses spaces and the MQTT wildcards
status is retained state, not a stream - it may not be minted through the live-event builder
Console is a live-event GUI root, not a state root. GUI_STATE_ROOTS is closed for the reason BAREMETAL_TARGETS is: a grammar with a hole admits the next drift invisibly
slash injection in a state path segment - the tail is plain segments, not addresses
mount-multiviewer.js publishes retain: false, so the Wall is deliberately NOT a state root
Mixer is a state root - gui.state mints it, with its retain class
a seat leaf second-to-last - gui.seat mints it
Gui alone is the root, not a topic to publish
a client id is one segment
a space forks nothing but is not T4 - sanitize_segment first
a slash in a game name would deepen the tree
a bare unit is not a command
a slash in a name would deepen the tree
a wildcard in a reply topic would widen it
a bare node is the census's root, not a leaf
a node is one segment
the root is a prefix, not a table
a slash in a command

parse.why: the deviceId charset, pinned as a NEGATIVE: D2 requires a {protocol}: prefix and nothing else in this corpus fails for want of one, so widening DEVICE_ID_RE was invisible to every reader
a space in a plain segment. SEGMENT_RE forbids it; MQTT does not, so only the grammar catches it
a space in an ADDRESS segment. ADDRESS_RE is deliberately wide - dots and colons are legal - and the space is the boundary that keeps it from admitting anything at all
a space in a bareMetal tail. The tail is addresses because a {host} may be an FQDN; that is not a licence for a space

the desk's retained settings root. mixer-bus.js:75 moved it off System/Gui on 2026-09-02 and it then parsed gui, which tree.ts declares live-event while :106 publishes retain: true - the T5 disagreement PLAN-274.01 closed by splitting the retained roots into their own family. Both halves are now pinned: the topic AND its retain class
the VCA half of the same desk - mixer-bus.js mixerApplyVcaFromBus - so the family is pinned on both leaf shapes and not only on Strip

useSamplerSets.js:481 through mqttBus.js:99 retain: true. A whole-leaf root with NO tail, which is why the path below a state root is zero-or-more; a one-or-more rule would drop this topic back into gui and into the wrong retain class
useSeqState.js:17 through mqttBus.js:99, whose comment states the rule this family encodes - retained because it is STATE and not an event
bim-store.js:19, published retain: true at :432 - the third publisher that disagreed with the gui family's live-event class
the CONTROL side of the split, pinned so widening GUI_STATE_ROOTS cannot quietly swallow the live-event half. A Console frame publishes a gesture; MqttProvider.jsx:1013 sends it retain: false
a bare state root parses guiState with an empty path, the same way APK.audio/Gui alone parses gui with no segments

was pinned as a NEGATIVE (PLAN-263.01: re-topic rather than widen the grammar). PLAN-263.01 is off the roadmap with no re-topic made, the 30 retained tables are still the live wire, and System/Gui/Panels was declared on the same reasoning (6a93285ca); declared 2026-10-30 at NODE.BareMetal's request so the root is held by a family instead of hand-written in five places. A re-topic remains possible as a staged change (VERSIONING.md).
mixer-score.js:130, published retain: true at mixer-score.js:178. The second undeclared publisher on the same root, and unlike Discovered it is browser-only, so it is the cheap half of PLAN-263.01
mount-multiviewer.js:49, published retain: false at :126. Undeclared like the others but NOT retained, which is why it costs nothing to move and why it is listed apart from them

one seat per shell per display - bus-check-in.js:81 retain: true. Measured off the bench broker on 2026-09-03, where it was one of the two retained topics still on the ApkOs/ root this family folded in

who is in the room - chat-room.js:68,:285 retain: true, and the other retained ApkOs/ topic on the broker that day. ONE path segment against the seat above two, which is what pins the rest below Gui as zero-or-more rather than a count

raise-sos.js:172 retain: true, and its own header worked example. NOT a seat - a standing call that outlives whoever raised it - but the same shape and the same retain class, which is what a family is

the seat arm is tested BEFORE guiState, so a seat under a name that is also a GUI_STATE_ROOT is still a seat. Both are retained-state so the retain class agrees either way; the KIND is what this vector pins

a seat leaf with NO client after it is not a seat. The last segment is the identity making the claim, and a topic that stops at the leaf names nobody - so it falls through to gui, live-event, which is right for a topic nothing retains

filters.why: every agent's mirror, no agent named: the copy an agent keeps of the traffic it read (AUDIO.komand's Komand/monitor/in); PLUGIN.SQL's topic_ignore skips it
every agent's onward half of the mirror: what it sent on (Komand/monitor/out)
monitor holds exactly two directions; a `#` under it names leaves the convention does not have
the mirror sits one segment under the root; a deeper `+` matches nothing the convention publishes
an exact topic, not a filter: it parses as komandMonitor and needs no declaration
